caption: A single string of an upright bass is plucked, and the thick string swings visibly from side to side before settling.

sa.check: The plucked string swings visibly from side to side.
Only a single string is plucked; the others are not.
The order is pluck, swing, settle.

pc.expect: The string hangs as a sharp, still line until the finger pulls it; it swings from the pluck and only then; the other strings stay still.
pc.fail: The string swings before the finger reaches it; or a different string swings from the one plucked; or all the strings swing together; or the string goes still and swings again with the hand away from it.

pc.expect: The swing is widest right after the release and shrinks steadily until the string hangs straight.
pc.fail: The swing widens again after it has begun to shrink; or holds the same width for the whole clip; or the string stops dead from a wide swing to a straight line.

pc.expect: The string stays anchored at the nut and the bridge: the swing is widest between them and both ends stay put.
pc.fail: An end of the string lifts off the bridge or the nut; or the swing is widest at the bridge with the middle still; or the string sags and hangs loose like a rope; or the string stretches visibly longer.

pc.expect: The bass's body, neck and bridge stay still; only the plucked string swings.
pc.fail: The neck bends with the pluck; or the body rocks on its endpin; or the bridge slides across the top.

pc.expect: The same set of strings throughout; the plucked string stays one string and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A string appears or vanishes; or the plucked string splits into two; or the string passes through the fingerboard or the finger; or the bass changes shape.

pc.expect: The bass's varnish, the fingerboard and the tuning pegs stay the same.
pc.fail: The body changes colour; or the fingerboard's markings change; or a tuning peg moves while untouched.
